Mission Local reported that a male after-school worker at Everett Middle School was arrested by San Francisco police over alleged inappropriate contact with a student. The district said the school reported the contact and immediately contacted police; the principal then contacted parents and others at Everett. The story did not establish whether the man was an employee or volunteer of Mission Graduates.
